name: Nana-chan to Issho
original_name: ななちゃんといっしょ
source:
Nana-chan come back!!
Properly explore the inside of the school while dressing up, play at the schoolyard, or play with your favorite clothes.
You can change clothes in various places, do what you can do. Please enjoy the pleasant summer vacation that will last forever with Nana.
translation:
娜娜回来啦！！
一边打扮，一边适当地探索学校内部，在校园里玩耍，或者穿着你最喜欢的衣服玩耍。
可以在各个地方换衣服，做自己能做的事。请与娜娜一起享受永远持续的愉快暑假。
